what_to_detect: A creature whose base power/toughness an effect sets (7b) while counters and pumps also apply (7c): its P/T is the set base plus them, whatever the timestamps.
near_miss: A creature with counters or pumps and no setting effect.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: A creature whose characteristic-defining P/T (7a) is overridden by an effect setting its base P/T (7b).
near_miss: A creature with a characteristic-defining P/T and no setting effect.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: A creature under a P/T switching effect, the switch applied to the values the earlier sublayers produced.
near_miss: A creature with pumps and no switching effect.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: A text-changing effect (layer 3) rewrites a word in a static ability and the rewritten static applies to the objects its new word names.
near_miss: A static with no text change applying to the objects its printed word names.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: An effect removes all abilities from a permanent (layer 6) so the static abilities it had stop contributing to later layers.
near_miss: The same static ability, not removed, contributing its boost or keyword.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: Within a layer the effect with the later timestamp wins: a keyword granted by a static that entered after an ability-removing effect stays.
near_miss: The ability-removing effect with the later timestamp: the keyword is lost.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: A static ability granted by an Aura or Equipment takes the timestamp of the granting object when it is later than the receiver's own.
near_miss: The same grant with an earlier timestamp.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: Re-attaching an Equipment gives all its abilities new timestamps but keeps their relative order.
near_miss: The order of conflicting abilities changing.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: Attaching an Equipment gives it a new timestamp, which decides a conflict with another Equipment.
near_miss: A conflict decided by the earlier attachment.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: Putting a counter of a kind on an object gives every counter of that kind the new timestamp.
near_miss: A counter of that kind older than the effect it conflicts with.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: Turning a permanent face up gives it a new timestamp.
near_miss: A permanent already face up, whose timestamp is older.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: Transforming a permanent gives it a new timestamp.
near_miss: A permanent already transformed, whose timestamp is older.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: A characteristic-defining ability applies before the other effects of its layer, whatever the timestamps.
near_miss: The same layer with no characteristic-defining ability.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: A dependent effect waits for the effect it depends on, overriding timestamp order.
near_miss: Two effects with no dependency, applied by timestamp.
record_fields: gen-3 floating_effects F<timestamp> rows and entity order_rank

what_to_detect: A copy effect sets only the copiable values and the later layers apply on top: a permanent with a copy_of link whose counters and pumps are its own.
near_miss: A permanent that is not a copy.
record_fields: state.entities[]: token_script_id, name, types, colors, pt, mana_value, face_state, copy_of

what_to_detect: A face-down permanent has the characteristics of a 2/2 creature with no name, colour or abilities.
record_fields: state.entities[]: token_script_id, name, types, colors, pt, mana_value, face_state, copy_of

what_to_detect: A copy effect on a face-down permanent is overridden by its face-down characteristics: still a nameless 2/2.
near_miss: A face-up permanent that takes the copied characteristics.
record_fields: state.entities[]: token_script_id, name, types, colors, pt, mana_value, face_state, copy_of

what_to_detect: A copy of a face-down permanent takes its face-down characteristics, face up.
near_miss: A copy of a face-up permanent.
record_fields: state.entities[]: token_script_id, name, types, colors, pt, mana_value, face_state, copy_of
